name: POLYTEC HLDG AG INH. EO 1
summary: POLYTEC HOLDING AG is a developer and manufacturer of high-quality plastic, composite and rubber parts for the automotive as well as non-automotive industries. Headquartered in Hörsching, Austria, the company's products include plastic injection molded parts, fiber-reinforced components, and specialty coatings. POLYTEC operates as a full-service provider, covering the entire value chain from product design to series production.
